comparison: thesis desk: ARGUS vs optic-bitget (neromtoobad, Season 2, MIT)
same_input: Long MSTR perp into earnings — funding looks cheap
Long NVDA perp into earnings — funding looks cheap
Long TSLA perp into earnings — funding looks cheap
optic_setup: clone at research/repos-s2new/neromtoobad~optic-bitget, npm ci, full desk (read, evidence, Bull/Bear x2, Judge x3). LLM: the hackathon Qwen (qwen3.8-max) through an env-gated endpoint override added for this run only (its default is Venice gemini, for which we hold no key); three attempts per call, 300 s timeout, because Qwen returned a 504 on the first attempt. Its web-research row is Venice-only and errored. Windows broke its own CLI entry check, so a four-line harness (scripts/h2h-desk.ts) calls runDesk directly.
optic_missing_rows: earnings, news, positioning and fear&greed errored on every thesis (the bitget-signal tools that are dark); both abstentions cite the missing earnings and positioning rows as decisive
argus_results: argus.json: each answer leads with a measured verdict on the funding premise against the contract's last 100 settlements, then the earnings half — next report date (estimated when unpublished), analyst targets, SUE from SEC XBRL, 13F holders, Form 4 filings, valuation, and for MSTR its bitcoin holding against market value. 0 model tokens, 5-8 s each.

where_ARGUS_is_ahead: answers the earnings half optic reports as missing on all three
states a verdict on the premise measured against the contract's own history rather than leaving it to a model's reading
no model spend: 0 tokens vs ~97,500 Qwen tokens for the three
where_optic_is_ahead: synthesises everything into one call with a probability; ARGUS lists evidence and leaves the call to the reader — still true
verdict.state: TIED on the thesis-desk task as a whole: optic still leads on a single synthesised call; ARGUS leads on the evidence optic reported missing and on a measured premise verdict. Not OWNED — no outcome-graded comparison has been run, and the two gaps closed after the run have not been re-run head to head.
gaps_closed_after_the_run: a Polymarket row: market/prediction.py, in fundamentals, news, sentiment and directional answers
a coverage count: truth/coverage.py, every research answer names the sources it reached and any that did not answer

not_covered: outcome grading (did each thesis hold) needs elapsed time; latency is not compared because optic ran on Qwen, which is slower than its default model

baseline_run.what: optic-bitget's own desk (src/desk/index.ts runDesk) executed end to end on the three theses, outputs saved verbatim as mstr.json, nvda.json, tsla.json
baseline_run.its_code_changed: no; only the LLM endpoint/model/timeout became environment-overridable and a four-line runner was added

failure_cases: identical zero-funding cases got different verdicts through tied ranks (fixed the same day, before publishing)
ARGUS gives no single synthesised call or probability; a reader does the weighing
the Polymarket and coverage gaps were closed after this run and are not re-measured against optic
